QQ v92: CONDITIONAL PASS

Main issues

Main Stage1/Stage1.5 layout is mostly preserved: left nav, conversation list, message thread, right sidebar, and bottom composer remain separated.

The right member sidebar is more complete than earlier versions: member rows are present down the visible right column.

Announcement rows do not appear to be fully swallowed into the member list; the notice area remains visually distinct.

Message thread content stays inside the center region and does not visibly intrude into the right sidebar.

Bottom composer/tool area remains at the bottom and is not obviously separated by a large gap.

Remaining visual issues:

Right sidebar is still cluttered around the notice/member boundary. boundary_review_region still looks like a transitional leftover.

Member header/search/member-list hierarchy is not fully clean.

Message thread still has dense overlays: message cards, bubbles, timestamps/context boxes remain visually busy.

Some message parent boxes still look broad and review-only rather than clean final grouping.

Topbar remains crowded.

Allowed to continue into page_details / read-only PathGraph preview:

Hero/content structure is improved compared with the earlier very dense versions, but it is still visually crowded.

Latest News and Upcoming Events now have more visible list/group structure, but the row/section/card layering is still busy.

Cards such as Get Started / Download / Docs / Jobs are present, but internal text/link grouping remains dense.

No obvious new large wrong media-card slot pollution is visible.

Latest News / Events rows are improved but not clean; list row parents and text children still visually overlap.

Right floating/scroll area should remain review-only.

This is still too noisy to call a clean page-detail result.
